subject: general
question: Which of the following book was written by Swami Dayananda Saraswati?
solution:
The correct answer is__** Satyartha Prakash.**__

__ [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **Key Points__**

__
 
• Dayanand Saraswati__ wrote the book “__Satyartha Prakash__”.
 
• Satyarth Bhumika, Rigvedadi Bhashya, Bhumika, Sanskarvidhi are also written by Dayanand Saraswati.
 
• ‘Back to Vedas’ was said by Dayanand Saraswati.
 
• Arya Samaj was started by Dayanand Saraswati in Bombay.

 
• He translated the Vedas and wrote three books named Satyartha Prakash, Veda Bhasya Bhumika, and Veda Bhasya.
 
• Dayananda Anglo Vedic (D.A.V) schools were established based on his philosophy and teachings.
